mission.title: Intego Yacu
mission.text: Guhuza no gufasha abanyamuryango b'Abasilamu mu Rwanda binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga, no guteza imbere gusengera, uburezi, n'ubufasha bw'imibereho myiza.

vision.title: Icyo Turimbuka
vision.text: Umuryango w'Abasilamu ugenewe gukorana no kwifashisha ikoranabuhanga, uhuriwe kandi uzenguruka ufasha guteza imbere u Rwanda.

history.title: Amateka Yacu
history.text: Umuryango w'Abasilamu bo mu Rwanda urakomeza gufasha Abasilamu muri Rwanda. Uyu muryango ugabanya intara zose na disitriki, RMC itegura serivisi z'amadini, uburezi, n'imibereho myiza kubantu barenga 500,000 b'Abasilamu muri Rwanda.

m4.desc: Ayobora gahunda z'uburezi, imibereho, n'iterambere mu gihugu hose.

areas.educationDesc: Amashuri ya Islamu n'asanzwe, buruse, n'uburezi bwa Qur'an.
areas.socialDesc: Gufasha imiryango ikennye, imfubyi, n'abantu bafite intege nke.
areas.financeDesc: Gukusanya no gutanga Zakat, n'ubufasha bw'imari ku baturage.

areas.youthDesc: Gahunda zo guteza imbere urubyiruko, ubuyobozi, no kwita ku baturage.

whoWeAre.heading: Ummah Imwe,
whoWeAre.p1: Umuryango w'Abasilamu bo mu Rwanda (RMC) ni umuryango w'igihugu uhagarariye kandi ukorera Abasilamu mu ntara zose z'u Rwanda. Duhuza serivisi z'amadini, uburezi, n'imibereho myiza ku bantu barenga 500,000.
whoWeAre.p2: Dushingiye ku mahame y'ubuvandimwe bwa Islamu, RMC ikorana n'imisigiti, amashuri, n'abayobozi b'ibanze kugira ngo twubake Ummah ikomeye, yigenga kandi ikoresha ikoranabuhanga.
whoWeAre.point1: Iboneka mu ntara zose 5 na disitiriki 30
whoWeAre.point3: Ukwemera, uburezi, n'imibereho myiza ahantu hamwe
whoWeAre.point4: Imiyoborere igaragara kandi ishingiye ku baturage

story.title: Amateka Yacu
story.subtitle: Ibyiciro by'ingenzi mu rugendo rw'Umuryango w'Abasilamu bo mu Rwanda

e1.title: Intangiriro
e1.text: Imiryango y'Abasilamu mu Rwanda itangira guhuza imbaraga kugira ngo ikorere abaturage bayo ifite icyerekezo kimwe.

e2.title: Ubumwe bw'Igihugu
e2.text: Imiryango yunga ubumwe iyobowe n'urwego rumwe rw'igihugu, hashyirwaho RMC nk'umuryango mukuru w'Abasilamu mu Rwanda.

e3.title: Iterambere n'Uburezi
e3.text: Kwagura amashuri ya Islamu, imisigiti, na gahunda z'imibereho bigera mu ntara na disitiriki zose.

e4.title: Ikoranabuhanga
e4.text: RMC yakira ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo ihuze abanyamuryango, isangire ubumenyi, kandi itange serivisi kuri interineti.

e5.title: Ummah Iteye Imbere
e5.text: Gukorera Abasilamu barenga 500,000 hatangwa serivisi z'amadini, uburezi, imari, n'imibereho mu gihugu hose.

marriage.title: Serivisi y'Ubukwe
marriage.desc: Ibirori by'ubukwe bw'Islamimu, impapuro, n'inyandiko kuri abakobwa n'abasore mu muryango.

detail.overviewP1: RMC iyobora abashyingiranwa muri buri ntambwe y'ubukwe bw'Abayisilamu (Nikah) - kuva ku nama mbere y'ubukwe kugeza ku birori bikozwe neza n'inyandiko zemewe. Abahanga bacu bemeza ko ubukwe bukorwa hubahirizwa amategeko ya Islamu.
detail.overviewP2: Waba utangiye gusaba cyangwa wifuza kumenya ibikubiyemo, tugufasha ko inzira igaragara, yubahwa, kandi idatera umuhangayiko ku miryango yombi.
detail.includesSubtitle: Ibyo ukeneye byose kugira ngo ubukwe bw'Abayisilamu bwuzuye kandi bwemewe.

nikah.title: Umuhango wa Nikah
nikah.text: Ibirori byuzuye by'ubukwe bw'Abayisilamu bikorwa n'imamu ubifitiye ubushobozi hakurikijwe Sunnah.

certificate.title: Icyemezo Cyemewe
certificate.text: Icyemezo cy'ubukwe cya RMC cyemewe gitangwa kandi cyandikwa ku bashyingiranwa bombi.

guidance.title: Inama Mbere y'Ubukwe
guidance.text: Amasomo y'inama yerekeye uburenganzira, inshingano, no kubaka urugo rukomeye rw'Abayisilamu.

witness.title: Ubufasha mu Batangabuhamya na Mahr
witness.text: Ubufasha mu gushaka abatangabuhamya no kwandika neza mahr (inkwano) byumvikanyweho.

detail.processSubtitle: Intambwe eshanu zoroshye kuva ku gusaba kugeza ku cyemezo.

s1.title: Iyandikishe nk'umunyamuryango
s1.text: Abashyingiranwa bombi bakora cyangwa bemeza konti zabo z'ubunyamuryango muri RMC.

s2.title: Tanga ubusabe bwawe
s2.text: Tanga amakuru bwite, amakuru ya wali (umurinzi), kandi uhitemo itariki wifuza.

s3.title: Kugenzura inyandiko
s3.text: RMC isuzuma inyandiko z'irangamuntu kandi yemeza ko wujuje ibisabwa bya Nikah.

s4.title: Inama mbere y'ubukwe
s4.text: Witabire isomo rigufi ry'inama n'umuhanga wa RMC mbere y'ibirori.

s5.title: Nikah n'icyemezo
s5.text: Ibirori birakorwa kandi icyemezo cyawe cy'ubukwe cyemewe gitangwa.

detail.requirementsSubtitle: Tegura izi nyandiko mbere yo gusaba kugira ngo Nikah yawe ikomeze ku gihe.

requirements.r1: Irangamuntu cyangwa pasiporo yemewe ku bashyingiranwa bombi
requirements.r4: Ikimenyetso cy'ubunyamuryango bwa RMC ku bashyingiranwa bombi

f1.a: Iyo inyandiko zawe zimaze kugenzurwa, Nikah ishobora gukorwa mu cyumweru kimwe kugeza kuri bibiri bitewe n'uko bishoboka.

f2.a: Yego. Abashyingiranwa bombi bagomba kuba banditse muri RMC kugira ngo ubukwe bwandikwe kandi bwemezwe neza.

f3.a: Icyemezo cya RMC kiremewe mu muryango kandi gikora nk'ikimenyetso cy'ubukwe bw'Abayisilamu. Ku iyandikwa rya leta, kurikiza inzira y'ubuyobozi bw'aho utuye.

f4.q: Ibirori bishobora gukorerwa ahantu hacu bwite?
f4.a: Yego. Bitewe n'uko imamu aboneka, Nikah ishobora gukorerwa mu musigiti, mu rugo rwawe, cyangwa ahandi hantu humvikanyweho.

detail.ctaSubtitle: Iyandikishe nk'umunyamuryango wa RMC kugira ngo utangire ubusabe bw'ubukwe kandi ufate itariki y'ibirori.

fees.title: Amafaranga ya serivisi
fees.subtitle: Amafaranga ya serivisi y'ubukwe aterwa n'aho umuhango ukorerwa.
fees.clause: Amafaranga akwiriye agomba kwishyurwa yose mbere y'uko icyemezo cy'ubukwe cyemewe gitangwa. Amafaranga aterwa gusa n'aho umuhango ukorerwa — 30,000 RWF mu musigiti na 200,000 RWF ahandi hose.
